text:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate & latency spike in smart-routing pipeline (service: routing-decider) — 8xx/5xx elevated, routing loops observed. Pager notifying oncall. :rotating_light:

oncall-eric: Got the pager, looking now. Any customer reports?

sre-ana: seeing region fallback loops between eu-west-1 <-> eu-central. TTLs on decision cache are not respecting policy. Latency up to 3s for some requests.

ml-kim: my dashboards show a bunch of requests routed to variant v2-quantized which isn't compatible with current sequence-length projection; may be causing failures in runtime.

eng-mike: confirming, routing logs have entries like `route=smart->variant=v2-quantized region=eu-west-1 decision_id=none` — decision_id should always be present. Looks like tags missing.

oncall-eric: tagging SRE and runtime. @sre-ana can you collect a small sample of requests showing the loop?

sre-ana: grabbing a sample now. logs (snippet):
```
[2026-03-15T12:05:02Z] req=abcd1234 route=smart variant=v2-quantized region=eu-west-1 status=200 latency=2800ms decision_tag=
[2026-03-15T12:05:04Z] req=abcd1234 route=smart variant=v2-quantized region=eu-central-1 status=502 latency=3100ms decision_tag=
[2026-03-15T12:05:05Z] req=abcd1234 route=smart variant=v1-bert region=eu-west-1 status=200 latency=220ms decision_tag=
```

ml-kim: wow decision_tag empty on a bunch of entries. The routing-decision service should always attach `route_tag` and `decision_id`. Something upstream may have swallowed them.

observability-bot: Note: `decision-log` ingestion pipeline reported partial failures between 12:02 and 12:12 UTC — 12% of messages failed schema validation.

pm-lina: Any customer-facing impact? Which customers hit this? We need to know if any paid tenant saw degraded predictions.

eng-mike: tracing shows a few high-volume org keys (org:fastpay, org:edu-saas) had requests that ended up in the loop. Some retries triggered because client timeouts were being retried by gateway.

oncall-eric: Triage plan: 1) Mitigate customer impact ASAP — disable smart routing policy for eu region (force stable variant v1-bert). 2) Stop region fallback loop. 3) Collect logs for postmortem. Who can flip the policy?

sre-ana: I can flip it. Doing `redwoodctl routing set-policy --region eu --policy stable --variant v1-bert --expire 30m` now.

incident-bot: command accepted by oncall-eric: `routing set-policy` — change will propagate in ~45s.

observability-bot: FYI the decision-log reingest job is queued, but we need the raw messages from the routing-decision Kafka topic — some messages show missing headers.

ml-kim: Can we temporarily enable verbose decision logging in the routing-decision service? Add headers at emission point. I can roll the small config change.

eng-mike: Be careful — increased logs will hit our ES quota. If we do, limit to sample 1%.

ml-kim: ack. Pushing change: `routesrv.log.decisions=verbose sample_rate=0.01`

oncall-eric: Change rolled. Observability should show richer payloads shortly. Any visible latency reduction after policy flip?

sre-ana: latency dropped to ~200ms for the pinned orgs after the stable variant took effect. Error rates for routing-decider are trending down.

pm-lina: Noted. I'll start drafting customer comms for the affected tenants: short summary + ETA for postmortem.

incident-bot: SCOPED MITIGATION: smart routing disabled for eu region (30m window). Auto-scaling unaffected.

eng-mike: While investigating the missing tags, I grepped the repo for code paths that emit decision logs. There is a recent PR that altered header propagation in the async emission path (PR #2247). That PR might have omitted the decision metadata in some fast-path errors.

ml-kim: That matches my local repro. When a variant mismatch exception is thrown, the emission code short-circuits and sends a bare error without `decision_id` and `route_tag`.

oncall-eric: So root cause candidate: code regression in decision logging + mismatch handling leading to mis-attributed routes and fallback loops. Secondary cause: lack of schema enforcement upstream allowed partial messages into observability pipeline.

observability-bot: Actionable alert: Re-enable strict schema validation on ingestion and send a small reingest of dropped messages for 12:00-12:15 UTC.

sre-ana: Reingest job started. I'll keep it running and watch for schema errors.

ml-kim: I'll open an immediate rollback PR for the emission change and add a unit test for preserving decision headers on error paths.

eng-mike: Filed PR #2289 (rollback) and PR #2290 (unit test + stricter schema). Requesting reviews from @ml-kim and @sre-ana.

oncall-eric: Good. Next: handoff — I'm going off-call in 25m. @sre-ana can you take lead for the postmortem and follow the action items?

sre-ana: I can take it. I'll gather timeline, affected orgs, mitigation steps, and next steps.

pm-lina: Please include exact customers and whether any charged tokens were impacted. I'll coordinate comms and legal review if needed.

incident-bot: REMINDER: oncall change in 25m.

eng-mike: quick note — we need to add route_tag presence to our SLA monitoring and create alerts for missing decision_id in a single request's trace.

ml-kim: agreed. Also add a regression test in the routing integration suite that simulates variant mismatch and asserts decision headers are still emitted.

sre-ana: creating postmortem doc skeleton now: `/docs/incidents/1955011234-routing-emit-tag-gap.md` with timeline and action items.

oncall-eric: handing off to @sre-ana. I'm stable.

sre-ana: taking over. I'll keep the mitigation in place until the rollback and schema checks are in prod. If anything flares, ping me directly.

pm-lina: Thanks team. Estimated impact window: 12:02-12:14 UTC. Immediate mitigation reduced customer latency and error rate. Postmortem owners: @sre-ana, @ml-kim, @eng-mike. Action items: reingest dropped logs; rollback PR; add unit/integration tests; add alert for missing decision headers; include route_tag in SLA dashboards.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: mitigation in place, owners assigned. Follow-up: full postmortem due in 48 hours. :white_check_mark:

eng-mike: adding a followup note: we should run a one-off audit over last 30 days for similar missing-tag patterns to ensure no undetected regressions.

ml-kim: will do a quick audit and share findings in the postmortem doc.

sre-ana: closing thread, moving discussion to the postmortem doc. If anything new shows up, reopen here.

oncall-eric: thanks all. :thumbsup:
